name: Trivia Bluff
description: A fact with a blank and believable lies. Pick the truth to score; fool the class to score too.
when: When the class is flat and you want a bluffing game that teaches the facts on the way.

questions.question: Honey found sealed in ancient Egyptian tombs was still ___ after thousands of years.
The Eiffel Tower gets about 15 centimeters ___ in summer, because its iron expands in the heat.

intro.message:
TRIVIA BLUFF!

You'll see an obscure fact with a blank. Write a believable lie to fill it in. The class will then try to spot the truth, but your lie might fool them!

qshow1.message:
Round 1 of 3

An octopus has ___ hearts.

Write your most believable lie!

qlies1.prompt:
An octopus has ___ hearts.

Write a lie that could fool the class.

qvote1.prompt:
Which one is the TRUTH?

An octopus has ___ hearts.

qreveal1.message:
The truth was: three!

What the class picked:
{{qvote1.barChart}}

Liars, own up! Whose lie pulled the most votes?

end.message: That's Trivia Bluff! 100 for spotting the truth, 50 per classmate fooled. Run it again for fresh facts.

recommendedFor: Older students who can write convincingly. Customize it down to one round for a quick warm-up.
